chunks: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad, known as Ibn al-Zayyat, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us from Abu Ali Muhammad ibn Hammam al-Iskafi, from Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Ibn Muskan, from Umar ibn Yazid, from Abu Abdullah Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) who said:

When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) arrived at the valley of Qudaid, he said to Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him): "O Ali, indeed I asked Allah, Mighty and Majestic, to establish a bond of love between me and you, and He granted it. And I asked Him to establish brotherhood between me and you, and He granted it. And I asked Him to make you my successor, and He granted it."

Then a man from among the people said: "By Allah, a measure of dates in an old worn-out waterskin is better than what Muhammad asked of his Lord! Why did he not ask Him for an angel to help him against his enemy, or a treasure to help him against his poverty?"

Then Allah the Most High revealed: "Perhaps you feel like leaving aside some of what is revealed to you, and your chest is straitened by it, because they say: Why has a treasure not been sent down upon him, or an angel come with him? Surely you are only a warner, and Allah is the Trustee over all things." [11:12]

key_terms.قديد: Qudaid, a valley near Makkah on the road to Medina, where the Prophet stopped during a journey.
key_terms.وصيي: My wasi (successor/executor/trustee). A key term in Shia theology denoting Ali's designated successorship.
key_terms.يؤاخي: Establishing brotherhood (mu'akhah). Refers to the practice of pairing Muslims in spiritual brotherhood.
key_terms.يوالي: Establishing a bond of love and alliance (muwala). In this context, divine friendship between the Prophet and Ali.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet declare about Ali at Batn Qudaid?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates that the Prophet (SAWW) publicly declared at Batn Qudaid near Makkah three divine favors regarding Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS): a bond of love, brotherhood, and successorship. When a man mockingly dismissed these spiritual gifts as worthless compared to material things like food, treasure, or angelic military help, Allah revealed Quran 11:12 as consolation and affirmation of the Prophet's mission.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 5. He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad, commonly known as Ibn al-Zayyat, may Allah bless him with mercy, reported to me from Abu ‘Ali Muhammad ibn Hammam al-Iskafi, from Abdullah ibn Ja’far al-Himyari, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughaira, from Ibn Maskan, from Umar ibn Zayd, who reported that: Abu Abdullah Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, said:

When the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, arrived at the middle of Qudaid (near Makkah), he said to ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him: "O ‘Ali, I prayed to Allah for (a firm bond of) love between me and you, and He granted, and I prayed to Him to establish brotherhood between you and me, and He granted, and I prayed unto him that He make you my successor, and He granted."

A man stood up from the people and remarked: "By Allah, a (small) measure of dates from an old, coarse sack is better than what Muhammad prayed for from his Lord. Why did he not ask for angel to come and help him against his enemy, or a treasure to help him keep away his paucity?"

Then Allah revealed this verse: ’Perhaps you feel like giving away some of what has been revealed to you, and your chest is straitened for it, because they say: Why has a treasure not been sent down to him or an angel come down with him? Surely, you are only a warner, and Allah is the Trustee over all things.’ [11:12]
